description.value: Deville Coffee is a locally owned coffee chain operating since 2008 across Alberta and BC, known for small-batch direct trade beans that are sourced, roasted, and brewed in-house. Their espresso drinks are crafted with touches like organic vanilla and house-made chocolate ganache, and the menu extends to breakfast wraps and fresh sandwiches made daily by local bakeries. The Vancouver location is part of a growing network of community-focused cafes that take pride in knowing their regulars.
